title: Introduce harmonizer-driven manifest reconciler and changelog fragment generator
author: Rana Patel
description: Motivation: onboarding at scale requires deterministic, explainable metadata deltas and repeatable changelog fragments that tie performance profile changes to release notes. This PR introduces a Harmonizer-driven Manifest Reconciler which consumes incoming model manifests, computes minimal delta-sets against the canonical registry, synthesizes performance-profile linkages, and emits changelog fragment candidates and signing-ready release snippets. Design summary: 1) manifest_reconciler: deterministic delta algorithm with 'affinity fingerprint' to group variant families and preserve transitive compatibility hints; 2) profile-linker: attaches sampled performance profiles (latency/cost/quality tokens) to the manifest delta and points to the profile snapshot in the model-registry; 3) changelog-harvester: generates compact, human-readable changelog fragments with structured annotations for automated release assembly; 4) approval-hook: optional Linear/GitHub review gate that annotates suggestions and auto-drafts release notes. Compatibility: adds model_manifest_v2.schema.json but keeps v1 ingest backward compatible for the onboard CLI for a 2-week migration window. Rollout plan: feature-flagged in registry and rollout to opt-in projects for 2 days followed by global flip and a one-day post-rollout audit. Tests and validation: unit tests for reconciliation heuristics, integration tests with sample snapshots, added property-based tests to assert deterministic deltas. Operational notes: new metrics exported under registry.harmonizer.{delta_count,conflict_rate,profile_attach_success}, and a lightweight audit export in NDJSON for downstream indexing. This description is the full continuous summary for the PR and contains links and checklist references inline.

review_comments: Marcos Alvarez: Overall this looks good. Two thoughts: 1) we should add a guard to avoid linking ephemeral profile snapshots -- can we require a 'snapshot:stable' tag? 2) changelog fragments need a stable id that survives rebase. Please address before approve.
Rana Patel: Added snapshot tag enforcement and stable fragment id composed of manifest hash plus delta-seq. Updated tests to cover stable id behavior.
Elena Li: There are a couple of nits on error messages in manifest_reconciler.py and we should add a metric for rejected manifests. Also can we surface the delta size in the audit NDJSON?
Rana Patel: Addressed nits, added registry.harmonizer.rejected_manifest_count and included delta_size in the NDJSON export. Updated docs with metric descriptions.
Samir Gupta: Integration tests look flakey on CI when concurrent onboard events race. Recommend a mutex in the reconciler for the commit path rather than a db-level optimistic loop.
Rana Patel: Implemented in-reconciler commit mutex with exponential backoff and added a test simulating concurrent bundles. CI run green afterwards.
